criterionOutcomes.criterion: Starting from the V4 launcher at https://o2intelligence-v4-dev.metricell.com/launcher, with sign-in completed if prompted, the page shows a GIS module card with an enabled Open GIS control.
criterionOutcomes.reason: The attempt screenshots show the launcher with the GIS module card and its enabled arrow control. The corresponding browserUrl is the expected V4 launcher URL.

criterionOutcomes.criterion: Selecting the enabled Open GIS control navigates to https://o2intelligence-v4-dev.metricell.com/gis, and the GIS page loads without an application error.
criterionOutcomes.reason: The after-open and final screenshots show the GIS page with its map and controls loaded. The corresponding browserUrl is the expected V4 GIS URL.

criterionOutcomes.criterion: From the loaded GIS page, using the browser Back button returns to https://o2intelligence-v4-dev.metricell.com/launcher, where the GIS module card is visible again.
criterionOutcomes.reason: The screenshots show the loaded GIS page before Back and the launcher with the GIS card afterward. The corresponding browserUrl is the expected V4 launcher URL.
